title: Slim WebView evidence prose boxes
summary: Hide or summarize WebView evidence/prose boxes by default and keep only raw copyable artifacts visible with explicit defense metadata.
reason: Visible bordered prose/status/callout boxes were creating repeated visual clutter across the operator workbench. The UI now treats factual status as compact chips, hides empty/default guidance, and reserves prose boxes for raw inspectable artifacts.
behavior_before: Browser audit captured 115 visible prose/status/diagnostic boxes across the primary page and subtab matrix, including many empty guidance, read-only guardrail, and factual status paragraphs.
behavior_after: Browser audit captures 2 visible defended prose boxes across the same matrix: the copyable Completed pilot evidence Markdown artifact and the Advanced API contract artifact. Other audited prose boxes are summarized into compact chips or hidden by default.
manual_validation: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserProseBoxAudit.ps1 -Mode before - passed; baseline manifest LocalBase/UiScreenshots/prose-box-cleanup-before-20260619-002959/manifest.json captured 39 screenshots and 115 visible prose boxes

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserProseBoxAudit.ps1 -Mode after - passed; after manifest LocalBase/UiScreenshots/prose-box-cleanup-after-20260619-002910/manifest.json captured 39 screenshots, 1069 audited rows, 2 defended visible boxes, 0 offenders, 458 summarized, and 564 hidden

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserVisualClutterScreenshots.ps1 - passed; manifest LocalBase/UiScreenshots/validation-clutter-cleanup-20260619-003231/manifest.json captured 39 screenshots with 0 clutter offenders and 0 horizontal-overflow entries

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserDiagnosticsHandoffSmoke.ps1 - passed; emitted existing malformed ActiveJobs fixture warning while tests completed OK

npm run webview:prework:check - failed at webview:lint:budget:check with existing budget increases: warnings 721 > 664, complexity 107 > 101, max-lines-per-function 34 > 33, no-undef 430 > 381, no-unused-vars 148 > 146

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/smoke/Test-WebViewBrowserLayoutManagerSmoke.ps1 - failed on drawer inventory expectation: missing managed panel settings / Staged Changes; UI reported Current Changes and Save Candidate instead
rollback_plan: Remove the prose-box disposition helper and summary-chip styles, remove the app startup/refresh calls to apply prose-box dispositions, and remove the prose-box browser audit wrapper/test. The UI would return to showing the previous bordered prose/status/callout boxes by default.
notes: Only two visible prose boxes remain in the final audit, and both are defended raw artifacts: completed-pilot-evidence-markdown is the copyable Completed evidence Markdown packet, and api-contract is the Advanced API contract artifact. The screenshot matrix records one missing requested subtab because the current Launch page does not expose a Launch/Audit subtab button.
